name: Draft first touches for new inbound leads
description: Sweep HubSpot for inbound leads with no outbound touch yet and draft a first-touch email for each one worth answering. Follow the stored procedures 'Which inbound leads get a first touch' and 'How to draft a first-touch email to an inbound lead'. Read the installation settings included with this run and honour 'channel', 'budget_hours' and 'offer'. Use the response_budget function for each lead's remaining working hours and order the batch most urgent first.
response_policy: Every draft goes to the configured channel for approval; never send an email yourself.
